items.text: Kwathi emva komkhuhlane iNkosi yakhuluma loMose loEleyazare indodana kaAroni umpristi, yathi:
Nani 1:1–46
Balani ibandla lonke labakoIsrayeli abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, ngezindlu zabo, bonke abangaphuma impi.
UMose loEleyazare umpristi bababuthanisa emagcekeni aseMowabi, ngaseJordani eduze leJeriko.
Babala labo abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, njengokutsho kweNkosi kuMose. AbakoIsrayeli abaphuma elizweni laseGibithe babeyilaba:
URubeni, izibulo likaIsrayeli. Amadodana kaRubeni ayenguHanoki, okwavela kuye abakoHanoki; loPalu, okwavela kuye abakoPalu;
loHezironi, okwavela kuye abakoHezironi; loKarimi, okwavela kuye abakoKarimi.
Lezi zinsendo zabakoRubeni; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lantathu, lamakhulu ayisikhombisa, lamatshumi amathathu.
Indodana kaPalu yayinguEliyabi.
Amadodana kaEliyabi ayengoNemuweli loDathani loAbiramu. Yibo labo, oDathani loAbiramu, abakhethwa libandla ukuba baphikisana loMose loAroni; babengabeqembu labantu bakoKora abaphikisana leNkosi.
Umhlaba wavuleka, wabaginya kanye loKora ekufeni kwaleloqembu, lapho umlilo uqothula amadoda angamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu; wona aba yisixwayiso.
Kanti amadodana kaKora kawafanga.
Amadodana kaSimeyoni ngensendo zawo ayenguNemuweli, okwavela kuye abakoNemuweli; loJamini, okwavela kuye abakoJamini; loJakini, okwavela kuye abakoJakini;
loZera, okwavela kuye abakoZera; loShawuli, okwavela kuye abakoShawuli.
Lezi zinsendo zabakoSimeyoni; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amabili lambili, lamakhulu amabili.
Amadodana kaGadi ngensendo zawo ayenguZefoni, okwavela kuye abakoZefoni; loHagi, okwavela kuye abakoHagi; loShuni, okwavela kuye abakoShuni;
loOzini, okwavela kuye abakoOzini; loEri, okwavela kuye abakoEri;
loArodi, okwavela kuye abakoArodi; loAreli, okwavela kuye abakoAreli.
Lezi zinsendo zamadodana kaGadi; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane, lamakhulu amahlanu.
Amadodana kaJuda ayenguEri loOnani; uEri loOnani bafela elizweni laseKanani.
Amadodana kaJuda ngensendo zawo ayenguShela, okwavela kuye abakoShela; loPerezi, okwavela kuye abakoPerezi; loZera, okwavela kuye abakoZera.
Amadodana kaPerezi ayenguHezironi, okwavela kuye abakoHezironi; loHamuli, okwavela kuye abakoHamuli.
Lezi zinsendo zikaJuda; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisikhombisa lesithupha, lamakhulu amahlanu.
Amadodana kaIsakari ngensendo zawo ayenguTola, okwavela kuye abakoTola; loPuva, okwavela kuye abakoPuva;
loJashubi, okwavela kuye abakoJashubi; loShimroni, okwavela kuye abakoShimroni.
Lezi zinsendo zikaIsakari; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisithupha lane, lamakhulu amathathu.
Amadodana kaZebuluni ngensendo zawo ayenguSeredi, okwavela kuye abakoSeredi; loEloni, okwavela kuye abakoEloni; loJaleli, okwavela kuye abakoJaleli.
Lezi zinsendo zabakoZebuluni; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisithupha, lamakhulu amahlanu.
Amadodana kaJosefa ngensendo zawo ayenguManase loEfrayimi.
Amadodana kaManase ayenguMakiri, okwavela kuye abakoMakiri; uMakiri wayenguyise kaGileyadi; kuGileyadi kwavela abakoGileyadi.
La ngamadodana kaGileyadi; uIyezeri, okwavela kuye abakoIyezeri; loHeleki, okwavela kuye abakoHeleki;
loAsiriyeli, okwavela kuye abakoAsiriyeli; loShekema, okwavela kuye abakoShekema;
loShemida, okwavela kuye abakoShemida; loHeferi, okwavela kuye abakoHeferi.
UZelafehadi indodana kaHeferi wayengelamadodana, kodwa elamadodakazi wodwa. Amabizo amadodakazi kaZelofehadi ayenguMahla loNowa loHogila loMilka loTiriza.
Lezi zinsendo zikaManase; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amahlanu lambili, lamakhulu ayisikhombisa.
La ngamadodana kaEfrayimi ngensendo zawo; uShuthela, okwavela kuye abakoShuthela; loBekeri, okwavela kuye abakoBekeri; loTahani, okwavela kuye abakoTahani.
Le yindodana kaShuthela, uErani, okwavela kuye abakoErani.
Lezi zinsendo zamadodana kaEfrayimi; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amathathu lambili, lamakhulu amahlanu. Yilawo amadodana kaJosefa ngensendo zawo.
Amadodana kaBenjamini ngensendo zawo ayenguBela, okwavela kuye abakoBela; loAshibeli, okwavela kuye abakoAshibeli; loAhiramu, okwavela kuye abakoAhiramu;
loShefufamu, okwavela kuye abakoShefufamu; loHufamu, okwavela kuye abakoHufamu.
Amadodana kaBela ayenguAridi loNamani; kuAridi kwavela abakoAridi, lakuNamani kwavela abakoNamani.
Lawo ngamadodana kaBenjamini ngensendo zawo; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lanhlanu, lamakhulu ayisithupha.
La ngamadodana kaDani ngensendo zawo; uShuhamu, okwavela kuye abakoShuhamu. Lezi zinsendo zikaDani ngensendo zazo.
Zonke insendo zabakoShuhamu zaziyizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisithupha lane, lamakhulu amane.
Amadodana kaAsheri ngensendo zawo ayenguJimna, okwavela kuye abakoJimna; loIshivi, okwavela kuye abakoIshivi; loBeriya, okwavela kuye abakoBeriya.
Amadodana kaBeriya ayenguHeberi, okwavela kuye abakoHeberi; loMalikiyeli, okwavela kuye abakoMalikiyeli.
Ibizo lendodakazi kaAsheri lalinguSera.
Lezi zinsendo zamadodana kaAsheri; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amahlanu lantathu, lamakhulu amane.
Amadodana kaNafitali ngensendo zawo ayenguJazeli, okwavela kuye abakoJazeli; loGuni, okwavela kuye abakoGuni;
loJezeri, okwavela kuye abakoJezeri; loShilema, okwavela kuye abakoShilema.
Lezi zinsendo zikaNafitali ngensendo zazo; babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lanhlanu, lamakhulu amane.
Inani labakoIsrayeli lalizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu ayisithupha lanye, lamakhulu ayisikhombisa, lamatshumi amathathu.
INkosi yathi kuMose:
Nani 34:13
Josh 14:1–2
Ilizwe bazakwahlukaniselwa lona libe ngelabo njengenani lamabizo alotshiweyo.
Isizwe esikhulu usinike ilizwe elikhulu, lesizwe esincinyane usinike ilizwe elincinyane; yileso lalesosizwe sizanikwa ilizwe laso njengenani labantu baso.
Kodwa ilizwe lonke lizahlukaniswa ngenkatho; inkatho izakwenziwa ngamazwe, ukuze anikwe izizwe zaboyise.
Ilizwe lizakwahlukaniselwa izizwe ngenkatho, phakathi kwezikhulu lezincinyane.
Nanka amaLevi abalwayo ngensendo zawo; uGerishoni, okwavela kuye abakoGerishoni; loKohathi, okwavela kuye abakoKohathi; loMerari, okwavela kuye abakoMerari.
Nanzi insendo zikaLevi; usendo lwabakoLibini, lolwabakoHebroni, lolwabakoMahli, lolwabakoMushi, lolwabakoKora. UKohathi wayenguyise kaAmramu.
Obizo lomkaAmramu lalinguJokebedi indodakazi kaLevi, owazalelwa uLevi eGibithe; wazalela uAmramu oAroni loMose loMiriyamu udadewabo.
UAroni wazala oNadabi loAbihu loEleyazare loIthamari.
Nani 3:2
Kodwa oNadabi loAbihu bafa lapho benikela ngomlilo ongafanelanga phambi kweNkosi.
Levi 10:1–2
Nani 3:4

Bonke abesilisa ababalwayo phakathi kwamaLevi, kusukela kulabo abalenyanga kusiya phezulu, babezinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amabili lantathu; kababalwanga phakathi kwabakoIsrayeli ngoba benganikwanga ilifa phakathi kwabakoIsrayeli.
Yibo labo ababalwa nguMose loEleyazare umpristi, ekubaleni kwabo abakoIsrayeli emagcekeni aseMowabi ngaseJordani eduze leJeriko.
Phakathi kwalabo kwakungekho muntu wabakoIsrayeli ababebaliwe nguMose loAroni umpristi enkangala waseSinayi;
ngoba iNkosi yathi: Bazakufela enkangala. Kakusalanga muntu kubo ngaphandle kukaKalebi indodana kaJefune, loJoshuwa indodana kaNuni.
